title: "Where present-day machines stand"
format:
  html:
    css: slide-widget.css
    page-layout: custom
    title-block-style: none
    include-after-body: slide-widget.html
---

```{ojs}
//| output: false
import {tripleProduct} from "./fusion.js"
import {INK, MUTED, GREY, BLUE, ORANGE} from "./plotting.js"
rx = FileAttachment("data/reactivity.json").json()
csv = FileAttachment("data/wurzel_hsu_2022.csv").text()
font = ({fontFamily: "'STIX Two Text', serif", fontSize: "16px", color: INK, background: "transparent"})
group = (r) => r.concept === "Stellarator" ? "stellarator"
  : r.concept === "Tokamak" || r.concept === "Spherical Tokamak" ? "tokamak" : "other"
// Magnetic confinement only (Wurzel & Hsu 2022, Tables 6 and 7); peak ion density, tau_E*.
rows = d3.csvParse(csv.split("\n").filter((l) => !l.startsWith("#")).join("\n"))
  .filter((r) => r.table !== "8" && r.T_keV && r.n_m3 && r.tau_s)
  .map((r) => ({name: `${r.project} ${r.year}`, project: r.project, T: +r.T_keV, n: +r.n_m3,
    tau: +r.tau_s, nTtau: +r.T_keV * +r.n_m3 * +r.tau_s, group: group(r), design: r.shot === "Projected"}))
measured = rows.filter((r) => !r.design)
designs = rows.filter((r) => r.design)
colour = ({tokamak: BLUE, stellarator: ORANGE, other: GREY})
// D-T reactor window used in all panels.
win = ({T: [10, 25], n: [5e19, 3e20], tau: [1, 5]})
sub = (svg) => {
  for (const t of svg.querySelectorAll("text")) {
    if (!/[_^]/.test(t.textContent)) continue;
    t.innerHTML = t.textContent
      .replace(/_(\w+)/g, '<tspan baseline-shift="sub" font-size="72%">$1</tspan>')
      .replace(/\^(\S+)/g, '<tspan baseline-shift="super" font-size="72%">$1</tspan>');
  }
  return svg;
}
axis = ({
  T: {type: "log", domain: [0.1, 60], label: "k_B T [keV]", ticks: [0.1, 1, 10], tickFormat: (d) => String(d)},
  n: {type: "log", domain: [1e17, 3e21], label: "n [m^−3]", ticks: [1e17, 1e18, 1e19, 1e20, 1e21]},
  tau: {type: "log", domain: [1e-4, 20], label: "τ_E [s]", ticks: [1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2, 0.1, 1, 10]},
})
pow = (d) => { const e = Math.round(Math.log10(d)); return e === 0 ? "1" : e === 1 ? "10" : "10" + String(e).replace("-", "⁻").replace(/\d/g, (c) => "⁰¹²³⁴⁵⁶⁷⁸⁹"[c]); }
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
panel = (x, y, {w = 318, h = 400, guides = [], left = 62} = {}) => sub(Plot.plot({
  width: w, height: h, marginLeft: left, marginRight: 14, marginTop: 30, marginBottom: 62, style: font, clip: true,
  x: {...axis[x], tickFormat: pow, labelAnchor: "center", labelArrow: "none", labelOffset: 40},
  y: {...axis[y], tickFormat: pow, labelArrow: "none"},
  marks: [
    Plot.rect([0], {x1: win[x][0], x2: win[x][1], y1: win[y][0], y2: win[y][1],
      fill: "#B5500018", stroke: ORANGE, strokeDasharray: "4,3"}),
    ...guides,
    Plot.dot(measured.filter((r) => r.group === "other"), {x, y, r: 3.2, fill: GREY, fillOpacity: 0.6}),
    Plot.dot(measured.filter((r) => r.group !== "other"), {x, y, r: 4.2, fill: (r) => colour[r.group], stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.6}),
    Plot.dot(designs, {x, y, r: 5.5, stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 1.6, fill: "white"}),
    Plot.text(designs, {x, y, text: "project", dx: -9, textAnchor: "end", fill: INK, fontSize: 14}),
    Plot.tip(rows, Plot.pointer({x, y, title: (r) => `${r.name}${r.design ? " (design)" : ""}\nT = ${r.T} keV, n = ${r.n.toExponential(1)} m⁻³, τ = ${r.tau} s`})),
  ],
}))
```

```{ojs}
view === "three cross-sections" ? html`<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between">
  ${panel("T", "n", {guides: [
    ...[1e5, 1e6].map((p) => Plot.line([0.1, 60], {x: (t) => t, y: (t) => p / (2 * t * 1.602e-16), stroke: GREY, strokeDasharray: "2,3"})),
    Plot.text([0], {x: 2, y: 1e6 / (2 * 2 * 1.602e-16), text: () => "10 bar", fill: MUTED, fontSize: 13, dy: -8, rotate: -40}),
    Plot.text([0], {x: 2, y: 1e5 / (2 * 2 * 1.602e-16), text: () => "1 bar", fill: MUTED, fontSize: 13, dy: -8, rotate: -40}),
  ]})}
  ${panel("n", "tau", {guides: [
    ...[1e18, 1e19, 1e20].map((nt) => Plot.line([1e17, 3e21], {x: (n) => n, y: (n) => nt / n, stroke: GREY, strokeDasharray: "2,3"})),
    Plot.line([1e17, 3e21], {x: (n) => n, y: (n) => 2.1e20 / n, stroke: ORANGE, strokeWidth: 1.4}),
    Plot.text([0], {x: 1e19, y: 2.1e20 / 1e19, text: () => "nτ_E for ignition at 13.5 keV", fill: ORANGE, fontSize: 13, dy: -9, rotate: -42}),
  ]})}
  ${panel("T", "tau")}
</div>` : sub(Plot.plot({
  width: 960, height: 400, marginLeft: 76, marginRight: 90, marginTop: 30, marginBottom: 62, style: font, clip: true,
  x: {type: "log", domain: [0.1, 60], label: "k_B T [keV]", tickFormat: pow, ticks: [0.1, 1, 10], labelArrow: "none", labelAnchor: "center", labelOffset: 40},
  y: {type: "log", domain: [1e15, 1e23], label: "n k_B T τ_E [keV s m^−3]", tickFormat: pow, ticks: [1e15, 1e17, 1e19, 1e21, 1e23], labelArrow: "none"},
  marks: [
    ...[[1, GREY], [10, BLUE], [Infinity, ORANGE]].map(([q, c]) => Plot.line(
      d3.range(0, 201).map((i) => 1.5 * 40 ** (i / 200)).map((t) => ({t, v: tripleProduct(rx, t, q)})),
      {x: "t", y: "v", stroke: c, strokeWidth: 2})),
    ...[[1, GREY, "Q = 1"], [10, BLUE, "Q = 10"], [Infinity, ORANGE, "ignition"]].map(([q, c, s]) =>
      Plot.text([0], {x: 60, y: tripleProduct(rx, 60, q), text: () => s, fill: c, dx: 6, dy: q === 10 ? 4 : q === 1 ? 0 : -6, textAnchor: "start", clip: false})),
    Plot.dot(measured.filter((r) => r.group === "other"), {x: "T", y: "nTtau", r: 3.2, fill: GREY, fillOpacity: 0.6}),
    Plot.dot(measured.filter((r) => r.group !== "other"), {x: "T", y: "nTtau", r: 4.5, fill: (r) => colour[r.group], stroke: "white", strokeWidth: 0.6}),
    Plot.dot(designs, {x: "T", y: "nTtau", r: 6, stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 1.6, fill: "white"}),
    Plot.text(designs.filter((d) => d.project === "ITER"), {x: "T", y: "nTtau", text: "project", dx: 10, dy: -10, textAnchor: "start"}),
    Plot.text(designs.filter((d) => d.project !== "ITER"), {x: "T", y: "nTtau", text: "project", dx: -10, dy: -10, textAnchor: "end"}),
    Plot.tip(rows, Plot.pointer({x: "T", y: "nTtau", title: (r) => `${r.name}${r.design ? " (design)" : ""}\nT = ${r.T} keV, n = ${r.n.toExponential(1)} m⁻³, τ = ${r.tau} s`})),
  ],
}))
```
